# public-guard denylist: one case-insensitive Python regex per line ("#" starts a comment).
# A change that ADDS a line, file path or commit message matching any entry fails the
# `public-guard` check. Names that must not be published even here go in the repository
# variable PUBLIC_GUARD_DENYLIST instead (same format, newline-separated; Settings → Secrets
# and variables → Actions → Variables). The guard never echoes those entries.

# Private project names are not listed here (this file is public): they live in the
# PUBLIC_GUARD_DENYLIST repository variable.
